name: Dust Devil Debris
summary: Across Westfall, Dust Devils leave charged grit behind. Mages use it to enchant parchment and bind messaging spells into scrolls.

sections.title: Air Spun into Parchment
sections.body:
Dust Devils sweep across Westfall’s plains as violent whirlwinds. When one falls, the living storm collapses into charged dust and grit called Dust Devil Debris. A faint trace of the elemental vortex lingers in the residue.

In Stormwind, arcane practitioners such as Collin Mauren prize the grit for specialized sorcery. Mixed into enchanted ink and parchment, it helps a wizard bind an airy messaging spell to a scroll, carrying words across the kingdom.

faq.q: What is Dust Devil Debris used for?
faq.answer: Collin Mauren uses Dust Devil Debris to craft a specialized messaging scroll. Its lingering elemental energy helps him bind delicate communication magic to paper.

faq.q: Where does this debris come from?
faq.answer: Dust Devil Debris comes from Dust Devils, hostile air elementals that roam Westfall’s barren farmlands and roads.
Dust Devils are hostile air elementals that roam Westfall. Collin Mauren warns that gathering their debris means facing dangerous creatures.
Collin Mauren is a human mage in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter. He uses his arcane knowledge to craft enchanted scrolls and magical components for fellow practitioners and curious researchers.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how elemental remnants aid scribing and communication magic, joining raw elemental chaos with arcane discipline.
